The '''Duneeden system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] in the [[Corusca sector/Legends|Corusca sector]] near the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Galactic Core]]. The system was home to the planet [[Duneeden]], which was a ice world that was rarely visited except for a few private retreats, despite its closeness to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].
